edges.reason: Ownable constructor assigns _owner from msg.sender.
msg.sender becomes the initial privileged owner.
Ownable constructor reads msg.sender to seed ownership.
isOwner compares caller-supplied msg.sender against _owner.
isOwner reads the _owner state variable.
owner() returns the stored _owner value.
renounceOwnership overwrites the privileged _owner slot.
transferOwnership delegates to _transferOwnership.
newOwner parameter flows into transferOwnership.
_transferOwnership copies the newOwner parameter into privilege storage.
_transferOwnership writes the _owner state variable.
Constructor argument becomes the privileged controller address.
RebasedOracle constructor writes the controller state variable.
Constructor argument becomes the REB2/ETH pair reference.
Constructor argument becomes the USDC/ETH pair reference.
Constructor stores the REB2/ETH pair reference.
Constructor stores the USDC/ETH pair reference.
onlyControllerOrOwner gates update() on caller-supplied msg.sender.
Stored controller is compared against msg.sender in the modifier.
owner() is called inside the onlyControllerOrOwner modifier.
update() calls getRebEthRate().
update() calls getUsdcEthRate().
update() performs the privileged baseline state writes.
REB/ETH rate returned by getRebEthRate is stored during update.
USDC/ETH rate returned by getUsdcEthRate is stored during update.
Computed REB/ETH average local is written to state in update().
Computed USDC/ETH average local is written to state in update().
update() writes reb2EthPrice0CumulativeLast.
update() writes reb2EthPrice1CumulativeLast.
update() writes reb2EthBlockTimestampLast.
update() writes usdcEthPrice0CumulativeLast.
update() writes usdcEthPrice1CumulativeLast.
update() writes usdcEthBlockTimestampLast.
getRebEthRate executes unchecked subtraction and division.
Stored baseline is subtracted from the live cumulative price.
Stored baseline timestamp is subtracted from the current timestamp.
block.timestamp feeds the time-weighted average denominator.
Unchecked arithmetic result is assigned to rebEthAverage.
getUsdcEthRate executes unchecked subtraction and division.
Stored USDC/ETH baseline is subtracted from the live cumulative price.
Stored USDC/ETH baseline timestamp is subtracted from the current timestamp.
block.timestamp feeds the USDC/ETH average denominator.
Unchecked arithmetic result is assigned to usdcEthAverage.
getRebEthRate consumes block.timestamp for its TWAP computation.
getUsdcEthRate consumes block.timestamp for its TWAP computation.
getData() calls getRebEthRate().
getData() calls getUsdcEthRate().
getData() performs unchecked multiplication and division on the two rates.
Locally captured REB/ETH average is used in the arithmetic.
USDC/ETH average feeds the final price arithmetic.
Computed answer local is returned by getData().
Arithmetic result is returned as the oracle answer.
getRebEthRate reads reb2EthBlockTimestampLast.
getRebEthRate reads reb2EthPrice0CumulativeLast.
getUsdcEthRate reads usdcEthPrice0CumulativeLast.
getUsdcEthRate reads usdcEthBlockTimestampLast.
Privileged baseline update interacts with external Uniswap pair contracts whose data can change or reenter before state finalization.

normalization_plan.reason: newOwner is only used to forward into the ownership transfer flow of transferOwnership.
newOwner is directly written into the _owner state slot by _transferOwnership.
_controller parameter is consumed only by the constructor to set the controller state variable.
__reb2_eth parameter is consumed only by the constructor to set the REB2/ETH pair reference.
__usdc_reb parameter is consumed only by the constructor to set the USDC/ETH pair reference.
rebEthAverage is the direct result of the unchecked subtraction/division expression in getRebEthRate.
usdcEthAverage is the direct result of the unchecked subtraction/division expression in getUsdcEthRate.
rebEthAverage in update() exists only to receive and persist the REB/ETH rate.
usdcEthAverage in update() exists only to receive and persist the USDC/ETH rate.
answer is produced by the unchecked multiplication/division that derives the oracle price.
rebEthAverage in getData() is a direct operand of the final price arithmetic expression.
